title: Argentina footballer Paredes collapses during post-match interview
html:
Argentina footballer Paredes collapses during post-match interview

Argentinian footballer Leandro Paredes collapsed during a post-match interview after Boca Juniors’ Copa Sudamericana title win in Colombia, where temperatures topped 30°C. He later said it was ‘just dizziness’.
summary: Argentinian footballer Leandro Paredes collapsed during a post-match interview after their win in Colombia.
